x: I will press it!

To the window with a curtain

The lock is like new!

Yesterday we oiled the lock and the key turned, and {thing} grows twice as fast!

Backwards: "worg"! It did not work!

I get it: the other way round is not letters but meaning! The opposite of "grow" is "shrink"!
All together!
Three, two, one, we say the magic words!
Louder, all together: three, two, one! Let {thing} hear the magic words!

q: What is written on the key?
Say it the other way round

rec: We are on an ant!

Yesterday we rode on an ant, and now a huge drop swells above its path!
We fly on a fluff!
The fluff carries us, and a drop is above!
Yesterday a fluff carried us off, and now a huge drop swells above us!
